source_locator: R1948: renamed II./Flak-Sturm-Regiment 1 on 24 June 1944 / R1938: II./Flak-Sturm-Regiment 1 formed 24 June 1944 at Bayeux with batteries 7-12
notes: Event date: 24 June 1944 (Holm, day date). Event definition: the battalion was re-formed at Bayeux on this date. Event support: one source family (Holm, ww2.dk; two pages). Location: Bayeux (place PL0033) with a precision of 5 km (the place point has 1 km; the claim uses 5 km because a headquarters or battalion given only by its town is recorded at 5 km). Location support: Holm names Bayeux. Review: confidence 0.5 from the rubric (G-b/L7: Holm day date (0.5)); added in the Luftwaffe ground G-b pass (branch normandy-lw-ground-b, 19 November 2026): old value none, new value this claim; parent_unit_id old value none, new value blank, reason: parents are left blank on claim rows (the chain is in the command relations). Context: The renaming is an alternate name (G3), not a new unit. Bayeux was in Allied hands from 7 June 1944, so Holm's "Bayeux" may stand for the Bayeux sector (open question). Holm's Abteilung page has the battalion under 13. Flak-Division (regiment staff 15) on 1 June 1944 (note).
